notes.title: Pre-release hotfix
notes.notes:
I've just pushed an update concerning the following issues:

[list]
[*] fixed broken and misaligned icons in the tutorial text
[*] fixed an issue that could cause the zoom go out of bounds
[*] fixed an issue causing severe FPS drops the longer the game was running. This was caused by the water which had to be downgraded in quality.
[/list]

If you got a beta key via the Curator Connect program [i]please[/i] test this version and adapt any review you might have written. Thank you!
